Subnormal endpoints, normal transition, and largest finite neighbors
Every finite binary exponent field from 0 through 2046, with significands 0, 1, and the maximum fraction, under both signs
2048 deterministic xorshift states, seed 0x4d595df4d0f33173, used for unsigned, signed, and finite binary64 round trips
Integration with lex_number, parse_f64, and convert_float verifies identical binary64 bits
Finite output under exponent limits 0, 1, 307, 308, 309, 323, 324, and 32767
Ordinary notation has no explicit exponent and satisfies every valid exponent limit
Quoted-integer and non-finite parsing permissions do not alter finite output
Positive and negative infinities, signaling NaNs, quiet NaNs, and varied NaN payloads always produce NumberOverflow before sink calls
Exponent limits -1 and i16::MIN produce ConstraintViolation before other value checks
